meta_description:
503K likes, 600 comments - tanyakhanijow on March 12, 2025: "Watch the entire vlog on YouTube!

Throwback to my favourite experience and reel from past year because the full fledged vlog from this day is now live on my YouTube channel. It is not just about this day but also randomly seeing northern lights on a grocery store run, and a hike in between canyons to see frozen waterfalls! 

If you’re having your chai or coffee, dinner or breakfast, it is a perfect 20 minute watch which I promise will make you feel some emotions! And you’ll fall in love with the cold. 

Take a moment and give it a watch. ❤️😘

In collaboration with @getyourguide".
